module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Zero Remainder Perfect Division
precondition: Master opens 2.00 lots across 4 accounts ($10k each). Math: 2.00 / 4 = 0.50 lots each.
expected_result: Each account receives 0.500000 lots; Remainder == 0.00 lots; zero policy intervention needed.
actual_result: Zero remainder detected; perfect symmetric apportionment of 0.50 lots across all 4 sub-accounts.
